prompt: Find the surface area of a $5 \times 3 \times 2$ rectangular prism.
hint: Surface area is the sum of all six faces. Because opposite faces match, you only need three different areas.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Unfold the prism in your mind. The net shows a $5 \times 3$ rectangle twice, a $5 \times 2$ rectangle twice, and a $3 \times 2$ rectangle twice.
Surface area is the sum of all six faces. Because opposite faces match, you only need three different areas.
The three areas are $5 \times 3 = 15$, $5 \times 2 = 10$ and $3 \times 2 = 6$. Add them, then multiply the sum by $2$.
$2(15 + 10 + 6) = 2 \times 31 = 62$, so the surface area is $62$ square units.

explanation: Find the three different face areas: $5 \times 3 = 15$, $5 \times 2 = 10$ and $3 \times 2 = 6$.
Add them to get the area of one face of each kind: $15 + 10 + 6 = 31$.
Double the sum because each face has a matching opposite face: $2 \times 31 = 62$.
The surface area of the prism is $62$ square units.
